fusions.name: Strand Barrage
fusions.desc: Looses 5 barbed rootlets at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Each hit has a 20% chance of [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Matted Snarl
fusions.desc: Flings a mat of woven roots that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught in the Tangle
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Root-Woven Mail
fusions.desc: Conjures a coat of root-woven stone: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it. Your armour rises by a further 4%.
